purpose: Short local runtime, memory, determinism and checkpoint benchmark of the registered simulator reward bridge before any extended rollout; no reward from these runs enters a ranking
bridge: experiments/simulator_reward_adapter_v2.make_compatible_env with map Infsaal3, random_start false, pose_start true, min_vel 0, max_vel 2, eval false, as the registered smoke used

start.rule: the eligible corrected real-v2 evaluation-agent recording with the lowest start row under the registered exclusion; pose is poses_x, poses_y and atan2(theta_sin, theta_cos) of its first row; velocity is previous_action_speed of that row, the commanded speed in effect at the recording start
start.public_record: start row index and SHA-256 of the JSON list [x, y, theta, velocity]; the values stay in the private step ledger
start.measured_linear_vels_x_note: the measured longitudinal speed at that row is recorded privately; it is near rest and is not used as the start velocity

stop: first termination or truncation, or 250 executed control steps
environment_reuse: one bridge environment per mode, reset before every run, as an extended rollout loop would do; the restart run uses the restored copy

modes.fixed: registered pose and velocity; normalized action [0, 0] every step; env.reset(seed=seed)
modes.seeded_actions: registered pose and velocity; normalized action drawn each step from numpy.random.default_rng(seed).uniform(-1, 1, size=2); env.reset(seed=seed)
modes.env_velocity: registered pose, no velocity supplied so the candidate RandomResetVelocity wrapper draws one; normalized action [0, 0]; env.reset(seed=seed)

recorded_per_step: normalized action, the returned observation arrays, the four reward components, the selected reward, terminated, truncated and collision; each step hashed with SHA-256 over the raw bytes in a fixed key order

determinism_checks.same_seed: the two runs of one seed in one mode are bitwise identical in every recorded step (state, action, reward)
determinism_checks.across_seeds: in fixed mode, seeds are expected to be inert; in seeded_actions mode, different seeds are expected to differ; in env_velocity mode, differences between the two runs of one seed show that env.reset(seed) does not control the velocity draw
determinism_checks.global_rng: numpy.random.get_state() is compared before and after each env_velocity reset to record whether the reset consumed or reseeded the global generator

seed_propagation_hypothesis: from source inspection: AccelerationAndDeltaSteeringWrapper.reset and PoseStartPosition.reset call the inner reset without the seed; F110Env.reset reseeds numpy.random with its config seed 12345 whenever any seed arrives; RaceCar.reset recreates the scan generator from the config seed; RandomResetVelocity draws from the unseeded global generator; so the reset seed is expected to be inert and env_velocity runs are expected to differ between repeats

checkpoint.method: pickle.dumps of the bridge environment and the action generator after step 125; if pickling fails, record the error and use copy.deepcopy; if both fail, record both errors and restart by replaying the first 125 actions in a fresh environment
checkpoint.check: the restored copy executes steps 126 to 250 with the same actions and must be bitwise identical to the uninterrupted run; checkpoint size in bytes and save and restore time are recorded

runtime: control steps per second per run from time.perf_counter over the executed steps; minimum, median and maximum per mode; environment construction time
memory: resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss after environment construction and at the end of all runs, with the platform recorded

output.public: runs/bridge_runtime_benchmark/result.json with per-run summaries, determinism verdicts, checkpoint result, runtime and memory
output.private: per-step ledger outside git with its SHA-256 in the public result

no_ranking: steps, rewards and collisions here characterize the bridge, not any controller
